name: 07C — Kader / Vertrouwen
description: Diep navy, een evenwichtiger woordmerk en natuurlijke zakelijke fotografie. Een rustige documentstructuur maakt ruimte voor bedragen, voorwaarden en persoonlijk contact.
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / logo-brand.
Input image is the edit target: revive Kader / Finance concept.
Create a SIGNIFICANT DESIGN REFINEMENT that reads immediately as a credible, established business-finance partner. The prior version still feels too much like a graphic-design/tech studio. Change the brand expression itself, not merely add finance labels. Complete landscape brand moodboard, 1536x1024.

NEW DIRECTION LABEL: "07C / KADER"
Small optional descriptive specimen label: "VERTROUWEN".

BRAND EXPRESSION:
Quiet confidence, professional competence, clarity of terms, personal accountability. Contemporary European business finance, premium without luxury clichés. The visual identity remains bold and capable, not soft, medical, playful, racing or military. Use deep NAVY as the strong foundation with warm white and modest burnt-orange accents. The dramatic orange framing and visible drafting crosses disappear from main layouts. Strong aligned columns and fine horizontal rules organize information. The grid remains as a discreet structural idea, with a small graphic specimen showing it; never wallpaper the hero in a visible construction grid.

COLOURS, four flat swatches with exact readable labels:
"Navy #17324D"
"Oranje #DF673C"
"Papier #F6F4EF"
"Leisteen #6E7B87".
Deep navy and paper dominate; orange used very sparingly for one identifying square and important small status/action accents. Crisp high contrast. No pastel pinks, gradients, chrome or neon.

LOGO:
Keep name "revive", lowercase six letters, never Capital. Evolve the source into an assured upright BOLD neo-grotesk wordmark: slightly less extreme weight, open counters, more natural spacing and carefully balanced proportions. Strong, stable horizontal baseline. Retain the first r as part of the word, the tiny square notch/accent at its inner shoulder, and a square dot over i. No separate emblem before a second r. All letters equal main body height and consistent weight; r not oversized. Hero navy on paper. Reverse white on navy. True monochrome specimen one ink only. Standalone r icon on navy square, taken exactly from the wordmark. Make the logo more mature and balanced, not rounded wellness or italic sport. Show both generous hero wordmark and smaller digital-size specimens.

TYPOGRAPHY:
GT Eesti Display reference for headings and body. Use upright bold/medium/regular hierarchy, calmer headline scale, open spacing and comfortable line lengths. Numerals and aligned financing rows demonstrate precision. Keep specimen label "GT Eesti Display", "Aa", "0123456789".

PHOTOGRAPHY:
Replace monochrome source photo with sophisticated NATURAL-COLOUR business documentary photography. Business owner and experienced financial adviser in a modern, believable Dutch office, ages around 35–55, reviewing an organized financing proposal together with a laptop and a few relevant documents. Natural daylight, navy jacket/neutral shirt, composed engaged expressions, respectful eye contact, confidence without exaggerated smiling. Human and approachable but firmly business. No handshake cliché, no aprons, workshop, cars, medical, stock-market screens. Small secondary crop of the actual conversation/document, not a generic cityscape. No photo crosshairs or four-corner orange brackets.

GRAPHIC SYSTEM:
Thin navy horizontal rules; orderly ledger-like columns; restrained rectangular frames for key information; tiny square modules referencing the logo notch; small simple line icons for document, calculator, calendar, person. No scattered pixel clouds, racing strokes, engineering crosses, warning hatching, padlocks/shields/medallions or fake certification seals.
Show these primitives together in a clearly labeled graphic-elements specimen so the brand system is tangible.
Three-step process: "01 Aanvraag", "02 Beoordeling", "03 Voorstel".

APPLICATIONS MUST LOOK LIKE FINANCE:
- Website mockup with clean paper background, navy header/logo, a sober editorial headline, warm business photo, and an orderly financing summary: "Financieringsbedrag", "Looptijd", "Maandbedrag", "Kostenoverzicht", "Voorwaarden". Values are em dashes. No invented amounts/rates. Clear navy button "Bespreek je voorstel". A small visible "Je contactpersoon" area conveys human support, no invented name or fake contact details.
- Mobile screen titled "Je financiering" with aligned summary rows "Bedrag", "Looptijd", "Maandbedrag" and em dashes, "Bekijk documenten", and a clear adviser contact action. Spacious readable financial UI rather than dashboard decoration.
- Printed "Financieringsvoorstel": premium matte paper, navy typography, tidy ruled table with amount/term/monthly amount placeholders and a small "Voorwaarden" section label. Small orange square accent. Accompany with understated navy business card and letterhead using logo only. No fake addresses, phone numbers, claims or legal copy.

COMPLETE MOODBOARD COMPOSITION:
Visibly redesign the composition to create a mature financial identity study with generous breathing room. Upper half: refined hero logo and exact main slogan on warm white, strong navy reverse-logo area, and natural-colour advisory photography. Central foundation strip with all four swatches, type specimen, graphic elements, icon family. Lower applications: desktop, mobile, financing proposal, with clear and consistent finance styling. Include both slogans in legible places. Keep everything visually coherent, balanced and beautifully typeset.

ONLY THESE MARKETING LINES, verbatim:
"Financiering op het moment dat het telt."
"Het antwoord terwijl iedereen aan tafel zit."
Use first as principal brand statement, second on website/application.
Other text limited to direction/specimen labels and functional finance labels explicitly specified above, plus "Logo", "Kleuren", "Typografie", "Grafische elementen", "Iconen", "Fotografie", "Website", "App", "Voorstel".
DO NOT add invented slogans such as Samen verder, fake addresses, rates, statistics, assurances of safety/guaranteed approval, regulatory badges, reviews, testimonials or certifications.
Outcome: a recognizable evolution of Kader that feels financially credible and trustworthy through restraint, precision, transparent document structure and professional human presence.
